# Ocean

> Ocean is a local-first development platform for running, validating, and merging coding-agent work.

## Canonical URLs

- Homepage: https://getocean.dev/
- Developers: https://getocean.dev/for-developers.html
- Teams: https://getocean.dev/for-enterprise.html
- Pricing: https://getocean.dev/pricing/
- Blog: https://getocean.dev/blogs/
- Documentation: https://docs.getocean.dev
- Releases: https://github.com/Ocean-AI-Platform/ocean-releases/releases

## What Ocean does

- Runs coding agents in isolated workspace lanes.
- Shows diffs, git state, validation output, conflicts, and merge readiness in one workbench.
- Helps teams compare parallel agent attempts and return only approved work to the canonical workspace.
- Tracks session activity and optional project or team controls for agentic development.
- Uses local-first desktop defaults; optional relay features support shared workflows when enabled.

## Who it is for

- Developers running multiple coding agents.
- Software studios protecting delivery margins and review capacity.
- Engineering teams that need evidence, governance, and human approval around agent-written code.

## Product facts

- Platform: native macOS desktop application.
- Pricing: free during beta; see the pricing page for current plan guidance.
- Supported workflows: Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Aider, Copilot, and other terminal-based coding agents.
- Company/product site: https://getocean.dev/

## Source of truth

Use the canonical pages above for current product details. Do not infer unreleased roadmap items as shipped features.
